name: Bind Spirit III
body:
School conjuration (calling) [pact]; Level sorcerer/wizard 7, shaman 7, witch 7

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as bind spirit I†, except you summon a 3rdlevel pact spirit of your choice and bind it to your soul.
